Open.Name: Open/Close Statblock
Open.Hint: Opens or closes the statblock for the hovered token, or the targeted token if none is hovered.

Notifications.NoToken: Inspect Statblock: Hover over or target a token first.
Notifications.NoActor: Inspect Statblock: That token has no actor.

Errors.NoHandler: Inspect Statblock: no handler is available for the game system '{system}'.
Errors.NoData: Error: could not read this actor's data.
Errors.RenderFailed: Error rendering the statblock. Check the console (F12).

DefaultVisibility.Name: Default Visibility
DefaultVisibility.Label: Configure Statblock Defaults
DefaultVisibility.Hint: Choose which statblock elements players can see by default when a token is placed.

FlagStorageMode.Name: Visibility Storage
FlagStorageMode.Hint: Per Actor: tokens of the same actor share what is revealed. Per Token: each unlinked token keeps its own reveals.

ClearFlags.Name: Clear All Visibility Data
ClearFlags.Label: Clear All
ClearFlags.Hint: Removes every reveal and hide made by this module from all actors and tokens. This cannot be undone.

AutoRevealOnDamage.Name: Auto-Reveal Defenses on Damage
AutoRevealOnDamage.Hint: When damage is applied, reveal any resistance, immunity or vulnerability that affected it.

AutoRevealOnFeatureUse.Name: Auto-Reveal Features on Use
AutoRevealOnFeatureUse.Hint: When a creature uses a feature, reveal it on its statblock.

DebugMode.Name: Enable Debug Logging
DebugMode.Hint: Print detailed Inspect Statblock messages to the browser console.

PlaceholderMode.Name: Defense Placeholders
PlaceholderMode.Hint: How hidden defenses appear to players. Individual: one '??' per hidden defense. Persistent single: always one '??' at the end, so players can't tell whether anything is hidden.

ClearFlags.Title: Clear All Visibility Data
ClearFlags.Content:
Warning: this removes all visibility data from every actor and token in this world.

  • Every statblock element returns to its default visibility.
  • All manual and automatic reveals are lost.
  • This cannot be undone.

Continue?
ClearFlags.Done: Inspect Statblock: cleared visibility data from {actors} actors and {tokens} tokens.
